pull.title: fix(auth): upgrade Better Auth and SSO to 1.7.16
pull.body:
## What changed

- Upgrade `better-auth` and `@better-auth/sso` from 1.7.7 to 1.7.16 and regenerate the npm lockfile for the [November 3 security release](https://better-auth.com/blog/security-release-2026-11-03).
- Patch the optional private-deployment Better Auth provider. Hosted WorkOS remains the default and is unchanged. Overlay does not register the Expo or Electron plugins associated with the mobile/desktop advisories.
- Document private-deployment rebuild/redeploy requirements in the Better Auth runbook and add the root changelog entry.
- Use the owner's approved one-time install cooldown exception; `.npmrc` and its seven-day policy are unchanged.

Related affected repository: [Syllable security fix](https://github.com/LayerNorm/syllable/pull/7), which addresses the enabled Expo plugin separately.

## Risk and rollback

- Security or tenant-boundary impact: security patches to core authentication and SSO dependencies; no application auth policy or tenant-boundary changes. Private deployments must rebuild and redeploy the committed lockfile to receive the fix.
- Billing or provider-cost impact: none.
- Data migration impact: no application/Convex schema changes or database migration commands in this patch. No production deployment or secret rotation was performed.
- Rollback plan: prefer a forward fix. Reverting this dependency update restores known-vulnerable versions; if rollback is unavoidable, disable the exposed Better Auth surface until a patched build is restored. Hosted WorkOS configuration is unchanged.

## Verification

Passed locally on head `32ddc5540b9d131e54af164c08b3c2f9d7db50f8`:

- `npm run check:providers`: 19 tests plus vendor boundaries.
- `npm run check:config`: 43 tests plus configuration fixtures.
- `npx eslint src/server/auth/better-auth.ts src/server/auth/better-auth.test.ts`.
- `npx -y npm@11.11.0 install --package-lock-only --ignore-scripts --no-audit --no-fund`: synchronized lockfile, no additional diff.
- `npm run security:audit`: no unexcepted high or critical production advisories. The general install audit still reports unrelated findings, including dev dependencies; this is not a claim that every dependency advisory is resolved.
- `npm run typecheck`: passed after initializing the tracked desktop submodule and generating Next route types. The script fell back to TypeScript because Bun 1.4.4 was unavailable.
- `git diff --check`.

Merged current main, preserving both sets of changelog entries. Provider tests (19), config tests (43), their boundary/fixture checks and diff checks passed again on current head `0613606fbe946a0eb5459fa7f453b56efca75467`.

Current-head CI is settled: 22 passed, 1 failed, 0 pending, 1 skipped. GitHub build, tests, and code/security checks passed. The only failed status is the [native Vercel feature-branch deployment](https://vercel.com/divyansh-lalwanis-projects/overlay-landing/6XeBCPMAEriEgYm5sKqNJvfPmaob), blocked before build by the existing deployment-source policy (`git.deploymentEnabled` disables feature branches). This policy is unchanged from main; no hosted preview was requested. No application build failure or build events were recorded for that deployment. Local Node 22.23.4 produced engine warnings for unrelated packages requiring Node >=24; focused checks passed.

### Preview evidence

- Canonical PR URL: https://github.com/LayerNorm/overlay-web/pull/390.
- Current PR head SHA: `0613606fbe946a0eb5459fa7f453b56efca75467`.
- Verified deployment SHA and Convex backend: none; no hosted preview requested for this dependency-only patch.
- Routes and authenticated actions checked: provider/configuration unit tests only. No live SSO login or callback tested.
- Screenshots or execution evidence: local checks above and GitHub CI. CI-only rationale: no UI, configuration, or application auth logic changes; the hosted WorkOS preview does not exercise the private Better Auth provider. Private-deployment SSO smoke remains required during rollout.

- [ ] Sensitive changes: callbacks, billing, migrations, and tenant boundaries were checked on the isolated PR preview as applicable
- [ ] Schema changed: expand/contract compatibility and backfill/rollback steps are documented

Main changes automatically deploy to Vercel Production through Git integration.
Integration verifies the live SHA and affected behavior; backend changes also need
Convex synchronization from clean canonical main after matching web is live.
A successful preview build still needs feature QA.

+- Upgrade Better Auth and its SSO integration to 1.7.16, including the November 3 security fixes for private deployments. Hosted WorkOS authentication and the dependency cooldown policy are unchanged.
+

+## Security updates
+
+Use Better Auth 1.7.16 or a later patched release, and keep `better-auth` and
+`@better-auth/sso` on matching versions. The
+[November 3, 2026 security release](https://better-auth.com/blog/security-release-2026-11-03)
+fixes multiple authentication issues in earlier versions. Update using the committed
+lockfile, rebuild, and redeploy every private deployment using Better Auth.
+
+Overlay configures SSO, JWT, and Next.js cookie integration, not the Better Auth Expo
+or Electron plugins associated with the critical mobile and high-severity desktop
+advisories. Hosted WorkOS authentication is a separate provider. This does not remove
+the need to keep the installed Better Auth packages patched.
+
